name: rhp_native
description: GC write barriers reduced to the bare store (uGC has no card table)
note: uGC has no card table and never collects, so every GC write barrier reduces to the bare store. These are the hottest helpers in the image (hundreds of call sites).

wrap.note: The unchecked barrier carries the architecture in its name; module.S assembles the one of its target.
The non-RiscV64 name. Guest scans show zero references to it; it stays as insurance until a full workload confirms that it is dead.
